verdict.rationale: Edge0 is developed in a public GitHub repo with a local unit-test suite that runs without real weights (edge0-gh-21) and a documented backend extension point, a reserved `backends/cuda/` slot needing no core changes (edge0-gh-20). That suggests outside code contributions are technically feasible, but nothing documents a contribution process or how contributors are recognized. Missing for 10: CONTRIBUTING guide, open-source license, PR/review process, contributor or maintainer recognition path, and evidence of external contributors.
